parts.name: Single Arm Wide Mesh Retainer
parts.description: Clear anodized aluminum single arm wide mesh retainer for 15 series T-slot profiles and Ready Tube. Used to mount a mesh panel recessed within the T-slot or on the profile frame; slotted holes allow positioning, and it requires a backing plate (pg. 5-53).
features: Used to mount a mesh panel when it is recessed within the T-slot or on the profile frame; slotted hole to allow for positioning
Requires backing plate (pg. 5-53)
parts.dimension_notes: A = overall length, P = overall width, C = slot width, ø G = thru hole diameter, H = hole spacing (typ.), R. J = bend radius (typ.), K = material thickness, N = overall depth (end view)

suggested_hardware.description: 5/16-18 x 2.00” Flange Hex Head Bolt & Flange Hex Nut

parts.notes: Badged 15 and RT (Ready Tube). Material, alloy, process and finish come from the Material Specifications table on the continuation page 5-49, where the suggested hardware is also listed. Requires a wide backing plate (pg. 5-53; 15 series part 2437), which is screwed on with the backing plate hardware listed on that page (3114). Also sold together with the wide backing plate as 2435 (pg. 5-55). 10 series equivalent 2493; metric versions 20-2493, 25-2493, 30-2431, 40-2431, 45-2431 (not extracted).

remaining_doubts: 3960 (RT-only Ready Tube bolt assembly) is kept in suggested_hardware of the 15/RT retainers and sets (2431, 2517, 2519, 2436, 2435 and Black variants) because the 'Mount to Ready Tube' table applies to these RT-badged parts; a strict reading of 'attach only 15/F rows' would drop it.
Part numbers of the single arm narrow mesh retainer (pg. 5-46) are not on these pages, so 2436's notes cite only the page reference for that component.
